final_note: Name what's on your desk in French.

walkthroughs.body_html: French nouns are masculine or feminine. Le = the (masculine), la = the (feminine). 'Le stylo' (m) but 'la regle' (f). Just memorise the gender with the word.
'Dans mon sac il y a.' = 'In my bag there is.'. Then list items: un stylo, un livre, une regle. Un/une = a/an.
Add -s for plural (silent in French speech). Les stylos = the pens. Stay aware of singular vs plural.
